text: September 2026, Broadbeach Waters. Black mould streaks and grey staining covered a sandstone wall above gravel. We cleaned it back to its warm natural colour with the stains removed, and cleaned the windows inside and out, including tracks, screens and balustrades.
alt: Before and after of the sandstone wall blocks above gravel. Before: Close view of sandstone wall with black mould streaks and grey staining  in Broadbeach Waters
